issues.where: Visibility amplitude panel (bottom right, x≈1464–1696, y≈832–1072)
issues.problem: The plotted visibility points don't match the model curve drawn with them. The cyan curve falls into a first null at 3.6 Gλ and drops to 1e-2, but the ~10 white points sit along a straight dashed line at |V| ≈ 0.5–0.9 out to 6–7 Gλ and show no null. The 'null 3.65 Gλ' readout and the ring diameter 'd = 0.7655/ρ0 = 43.2 µas' therefore come from the curve, not from the data, so the panel contradicts itself. Also, only about 10 points are shown even though the readout says 2,688–3,528 visibilities have been sampled.
issues.fix: Plot |V| for every accumulated visibility (or a binned subset of a few hundred), using the same sampled visibilities that the dirty image uses, in faint per-baseline colours. Compute the azimuthal-mean curve and the first null from those points, so the dots follow the curve down into the null.

issues.where: Hero, left and right edges of the disk (x≈355 and x≈1215)
issues.problem: The disk's outer edge (r_out = 24 M) extends past the traced field of view (α ±20 M). The approaching-side tip is cut flat by the hero's left border, and the right lobe runs under the colorbar. The main visual is visibly cropped on both sides.
issues.fix: Widen the traced window to about α ±27 M (keeping the pixel aspect, or trimming β), or cap the displayed r_out at ~19 M. Either way the whole disk ellipse fits inside the frame with a margin. Move the colorbar into the empty starfield at the top right so it no longer overlaps the disk.

issues.problem: Between 2 s and 52 s the dirty image looks essentially the same: the same blob pattern, and no ring that sharpens, which the brief promises. Only the tiny 'imaged UT' and beam readouts change. Together with the uv tracks, which barely change at this size, the whole EHT row looks frozen on camera.
issues.fix: Re-image more often (every ~5 sim-min instead of ~35) and crossfade between images. Mark newly added uv points with a bright pulse that decays, and draw each newly risen track segment brighter for a few seconds. If the model really is a blob at i = 72°, relabel the overlay as the blurred-model contour instead of 'shadow edge', so it doesn't promise a ring.

issues.problem: The axis shows only −25, 0, 25, 50, 75 µas. The −50 and −75 ticks are missing because the 'KERR RAY TRACE' title block hides them, so the axis looks lopsided.
issues.fix: Move the title block below the axis strip or shift it right of x≈600, and draw the −50 and −75 ticks.

issues.where: Event log, line at 04:30 (19 s frame)
issues.problem: The line 'spot beaming peak: 27.6% of flux, 43.1 min after…' is cut off with an ellipsis. Its 27.6% also doesn't match the light-curve peak labels (36.5% of ⟨F⟩, which would be ≈30% of the instantaneous flux), and the log doesn't say which normalisation it uses.
issues.fix: Shorten the line to fit, e.g. 'spot peak 36.5% ⟨F⟩, ΔT 43.1 min', using the same normalisation as the light-curve labels.

issues.where: This PC panel, bottom right ('heap 0 MB')
issues.problem: The heap readout always shows 0 MB, so the measurement isn't actually available.
issues.fix: Hide the field when performance.memory is missing, or replace it with something measured, such as the number of live workers or the GPU frame time.

issues.problem: The red-wing extent sits exactly at the axis minimum (3 keV). With g_min = 0.15 the wing actually reaches below 1 keV, so the value is a clamp, not a measurement.
issues.fix: Report the true red-wing energy (for example, where the profile reaches 5% of the peak) and show '<3' with an arrow when it falls outside the plotted window.

issues.problem: The magenta label is drawn directly over the orange disk rays with no backing, so it has low contrast and is hard to read even in the zoomed view.
issues.fix: Give it the same dark backing box as the 'ISCO' and 'r+' labels, or move it into the empty space inside the dotted photon-orbit circle.

issues.where: Spin sweep panel, left end of both curves
issues.problem: Around a = 0–0.3 the i = 17° purple markers sit on top of the i = 72° orange markers, so neither series can be read there.
issues.fix: Use filled markers for one series and hollow ones for the other, offset them by ±1 px, or draw the 17° series on its own small secondary plot.

issues.problem: The overflow bin is labelled ≥468 even though the reported max steps is 426, so that bin can never fill and the label looks arbitrary.
issues.fix: End the axis at the measured maximum, or label the overflow bin at a round value (≥400) that matches the max-steps readout.

critic.summary: This is strong and very close to postable. I read all 12 frames and zoom views. The zoom views only cover the hero and the top of the right column, so the tiny text in the maps strip, uv row, event log and system panel was checked at full-frame size only. The layout follows the brief's grid exactly, the palette and fonts match, and the hero is a striking Interstellar-style Kerr image with useful overlays. The numbers hold up unusually well when cross-checked: r+, the photon-orbit radii, r_isco, θ_g, the time per M, L_Edd, the accretion rate and the orbital period all agree with each other. The hot-spot phase advances by exactly the elapsed sim time, the rays-traced counter grows at the stated ~490k rays/s, and the centroid readouts in the hero and the centroid panel match. The system panel is present and its numbers are self-consistent. What keeps it from an 8+: (1) the visibility-amplitude points contradict the model curve and the first null they are supposed to support; (2) the disk is cropped by the hero's left and right borders; (3) the EHT row, especially the dirty image, looks frozen across the 50 s and never shows the sharpening ring the brief promises. There are also a few small label and readout problems (hidden negative µas ticks, a truncated log line with an unexplained percentage, 'heap 0 MB', a clamped red-wing value). Fix the three major issues and this is an 8–9.
